title: Multi-question requests on vLLM 0.30.0 (why an answer depends on its batch, and --multi-question sequential), description-only option rendering (--describe-options), and per-request latency on fresh states
hardware: 1x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, a container on a rented GPU host

software.checkpoint: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 at revision 95a723d; the batch diagnosis also Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (bf16) at 995ad96
software.server: python -m decisio.serve.vllm_engine --model-class hidden-readout, plus each configuration's flag; one server per configuration, one request at a time

code.servers: decisio at a1f0121 (main 7aaa7f6 with the --multi-question, --pad-policy and --describe-options flags, all off by default)
code.batch_diagnosis: a private in-process diagnosis using the served request builder; its summary table and the stock-vLLM reproduction are in batch_diagnosis/

servers.default: the served default (first start of the session)
servers.default2: the served default, started again at the end of the session: the suite and JevBench, for start-to-start variation and to check the 2026-09-30 records the gates pair with

batch_dependence.stock_vllm_reproduction: batch_diagnosis/repro_upstream.py on 20 random 1,400-token prompts: alone repeated 0.0, alone against a batch of two 0.198, the same batch of two repeated 0.168 (max |delta logprob|)
batch_dependence.factors: batch_diagnosis/summary.md: prefix caching off, larger token budget, the Triton GDN prefill, CUDA graphs off, a bf16 recurrent state, the text-only class, cuBLAS's deterministic workspace and the bf16 checkpoint all leave it; one sequence per step removes it
batch_dependence.prefill_split: the same lone row prefilled in one step (prefix caching off) and split at the 1,056-token block boundary (on) differs by up to 0.44 in a probability, median 0.068, choice changed on 20 of 100 prompts: this model moves at that scale with any change of rounding

browser_agent_demo_steps.note: 272 results-page steps of a browser-agent demo, each the operation question alone and the demo's four-question request 5 times; aggregates only (the pages are not published)

results.suite_single_question: conformance_*.json.gz: C2 to C4 pass on every server; default2, sequential and describe equal the 2026-09-30 plugin-verification record (runs/2026-09-30_plugin-verification/conformance_H.json.gz) on all 1,400 items to 2.2e-16; the first default start moved 2 items (BANKING77 14 and 113) by up to 1.2e-3 with no choice change

deviations: The first server start failed to bind port 8000, which the host's portal holds; the servers then listened on 18000
The Decision Index kit's score step fails on its headline when part of an edition is run; the per-benchmark numbers come from di_report.json and di_cal.json, as in runs/2026-09-30_served-default
excluded: the browser-agent demo's pages and per-step answers (aggregates above)
the batch diagnosis's per-prompt files (summary table kept)
